items.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Accept continued lines in double-quoted jq programs**

When a valid double-quoted jq filter contains a shell continuation after content, such as `jq -r "select(.url == \\` followed by `\"/x\")"`, the stray-closing-quote alternative consumes the opening quote because it only searches the current physical line for the close. `programs()` then returns no program, so the raw path comparison bypasses R3; the locator needs to distinguish a backslash-newline continuation from an unmatched opening quote.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

<!-- codex-code-review-finding:v1 -->

items.author: chatgpt-codex-connector[bot]
items.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Remove backslash-newlines without inserting a token break**

A shell backslash-newline is deleted rather than replaced with whitespace, so this changes the meaning of valid continuations within a word. For example, `[[ "$x" == *\` followed by `/foo ]]` compares against the path pattern `*/foo`, but the buffer becomes `* /foo`; `words()` therefore sees `*` as the operand next to `==` and misses R1. Concatenate the physical lines without adding a new separator.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

<!-- codex-code-review-finding:v1 -->

items.author: chatgpt-codex-connector[bot]
items.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Keep quote state while classifying shell comments**

Calling `comment()` independently for every physical line loses quote state across lines. A valid multiline assignment such as `msg="` followed by `# lint-comparisons: allow` and then `"` is consequently reported as R0 even though the marker is string content, not a shell comment, which can fail the changed-file lint. Shell comment recognition must carry lexical state across physical lines (and similarly avoid treating heredoc contents as comments).

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

<!-- codex-code-review-finding:v1 -->
